MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES — TERMLY EXAM #16
====

GRADE: PP2
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 21
   B. 15.6
   C. 15.7
   D. 15

2. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 8 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 30
   B. 23
   C. 46
   D. 120

3. Which is greater: 1/4 or 2/2? (1 mark)
   A. 1/4
   B. They are equal
   C. Cannot tell
   D. 2/2

4. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 8 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 22
   B. 88
   C. 19
   D. 38

5. What is √25? (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 12.5
   C. 6
   D. 25

6. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 12x
   B. 6x
   C. 6x + 2
   D. 12x + 2

7. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 25

   C. 1
   D. 1

8. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)

   B. 1
   C. 49
   D. 1

   A. 31
   B. 1
   C. 1
   D. 2

14. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 23.6
   B. 23.7
   C. 29
   D. 23

15. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 37
   C. 1
   D. 1

16. What is √64? (1 mark)
   A. 32
   B. 9
   C. 64
   D. 8

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
